name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature, improvement, or a gap in the roadmap
title: ''
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## What would you like to see?

> One or two sentences: the feature and the concrete user it helps.

## Why does it matter?

> The problem it solves, and who runs into it. Reference an existing doc
> (e.g. `docs/PRODUCT/FEATURE_ROADMAP.md`) if you can — a maintainer can
> map it to a phase.

## Where does it fit on the roadmap?

| Phase | Fits? | Note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 — MVP | | |
| 1 — Trust & Scale | | |
| 2 — Depth | | |
| 3 — Enterprise | | |

> Leave the row(s) that apply; add a short note on why.

## Proposed design (optional)

> Sketches, data shapes, or the shape of the new API. Even a rough
> outline helps a reviewer. If you only have an intuition, say so —
> that's fine.

## Alternatives considered

> If you've thought of a simpler way to get the same value, list it.

## Acceptance criteria

> A checklist of what "done" looks like for this feature. A maintainer
> will use it to review the PR that implements it.

- [ ]
- [ ]

## Security / tenant-isolation notes

> If this touches `contracts`, `database`, or `github`, note whether it
> adds any new cross-tenant data path or any new surface for
> prompt-injection / secret leakage. Maintainers will review against
> [docs/SECURITY/](docs/SECURITY/) before merging.
